snippet.title: Apple IIGS Game: Solitaire Royale (1989 Spectrum Holobyte)
snippet.description:
There are 8 different solitaire games, including Klondike, Calculation, and Three Shuffles and a Draw. You can also play "Aunt Anne's Tour" where you play all 8 in row, trying for the highest combined score, and 3 children's games. In addition, there are 10 different choices for deck art.

Please like this video and subscribe to my channel for more great retro content.
